examples.arabic: فريقنا بلش اللعب مش منيح بس كان في لاعب طويل كتير
examples.english: Our team started playing not well, but there was a very tall player
examples.transliteration: farīqna ballash il-laʿeb mish mnīḥ bas kān fī lāʿeb ṭawīl ktīr

examples.arabic: في البداية لعب فريقنا منيح وسجل هدف خلانا كتير مبسوطين
examples.english: In the beginning, our team played well and scored a goal that made us very happy
examples.transliteration: fil-bidāye li'ib farīqna mnīḥ w-sajjal hadaf khallāna ktīr mabsūṭīn
